Session 1, $50k cash, no prior positions. Built a core momentum/quality tech book from 60-bar price history through 2025-09-30. Rationale: AI/semis complex in clear uptrend (NVDA 186.58 at a new 3-month high; MU 167.32 near highs after a big Sept run; AVGO consolidating ~330 after the Sept 5 gap; LITE 162.71 strong uptrend). Software/platform momentum: APP 718 (parabolic - capped at 4.5k), PLTR 182 near highs, SHOP 148.6 recovering. Mega-cap ballast: GOOGL 243 (Sept breakout, mild pullback), MSFT 517.95 (breaking out), AAPL 254.63 (strong since Sept 19), AMZN 219.57 (weakest, small size).
Skipped META (downtrend 790->734), COST (downtrend), MSTR (choppy, lower highs), AXON (broke down 789->698 on Sept 24), ARM (flat/weak).
Deployed ~$47k, ~$3k cash buffer. Roughly equal-weight 5-15% positions.
Reconsider/trim when a name breaks its trend: NVDA <170, MU <150, APP <620, GOOGL <235, LITE <145, PLTR <165. Next $50k deposit first session of November; will rebalance into remaining relative strength and add defensives if breadth deteriorates.

Day 2. Book is fully invested (~$48.1k holdings, $3.0k cash) and every position closed above entry on 10-01. Trend checks through 10-01: NVDA 187.24 new high, MU 182.15 (+8.9% gap day on huge volume), LITE 171.40 breakout, PLTR 184.95 near highs, AVGO 333.39 holding the range, APP 704 pulled back from 718 but still well above the 640 base. No trend stops hit, so no action. Keeping the ~$3k cash buffer rather than chasing MU/LITE after one-day vertical moves.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <170, MU <150, APP <620, GOOGL <235, LITE <145, PLTR <165. Will trim the most extended name (likely MU or APP) if it closes below its 10-day trend or if I need cash before the Nov 1 deposit. Next major rebalance at the $50k November deposit.

Day 3. Through 10-02 the book is still intact: NVDA 188.89 new closing high, MU 183.75 holding the 10-01 gap, AVGO 338.18 (reclaimed range after intraday 347 spike), PLTR 187.05 new high, GOOGL 245.69, MSFT 515.74, AAPL 257.13, SHOP 151.30, AMZN 222.41, LITE 169.75 (wide outside day, 178.5 high / 166 low, still above trend). No stops hit.
Only warning flag is APP: outside-day reversal after a parabolic run (open 710 -> close 683.64, below 10-01's low, third straight lower close from 718.54). Trimming 2 units (~$1.37k) to cut the most extended/weakening name and lift cash to ~$4.4k ahead of the Nov 1 deposit. Keeping the remaining ~4.3 units since 683 is still far above the 640 base.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <170, MU <150, APP <620, GOOGL <235, LITE <145, PLTR <165. Reconsider if APP loses 660 (would exit rest), or if two or more core names close below their 10-day trend, which I'd read as breadth deterioration and rotate part of the book into defensives (COST/PEP/WMT type) at the November deposit.

Day 4 (through 10-03). PLTR is the clear damage: outside-day reversal 186.84 high -> 173.07 close (-7.5%) on 105.5M shares, roughly 2.5x normal volume, first close below its 10-day trend and back under the late-Sept range. Stop level 165 not hit, but distribution on that volume after a run is exactly the signal I said I'd act on, so trimming ~10 units (~$1.73k), keeping ~12 units. Cash goes to ~$6.1k.
LITE is the second warning: 178.49 high on 10-02 -> 163.81 close on 10-03, two down days, now sitting on the trend. Holding for now; exit below 155.
Rest intact: MU 187.83 new high (strongest name), NVDA 187.62 (mild inside-ish pullback from 190 high), AVGO 338.37 steady, MSFT 517.35, AAPL 258.02 new high, GOOGL 245.35, AMZN 219.51, SHOP 161.14 breakout +6.5% on 15.7M shares (best new strength in book), APP 682.76 stabilizing after the reversal (still above 660 line).
Stops: NVDA <170, MU <150, APP <660 (tightened), GOOGL <235, LITE <155 (tightened), PLTR <165, SHOP <148. Reconsider: if LITE or PLTR breaks those levels I exit fully and hold cash into the Nov 1 deposit; if semis (NVDA/MU/AVGO) stay at highs I redeploy the cash there.

Day 5 (through 10-06). APP stop triggered exactly as written: 684.47 open -> 587.00 close (-14%) on 14.4M shares (3x normal), intraday low 545, decisively through the 660 line and through the 640 base. Exiting the remaining 4.3 units (~$2.5k) with no hesitation; parabolic name that broke down on volume is not something I hold.
Rest of the book is fine, so no broader de-risking: GOOGL 250.43 new closing high on 28.9M shares (best breakout in book), MSFT 528.57 new high, SHOP 164.50 second strong day, MU 190.96 still highest close though it printed 201 intraday and reversed (watch), NVDA 185.54 quiet drift, AVGO 335.49 range, AAPL 256.69, AMZN 220.90, PLTR 179.53 recovered most of the 10-03 flush (kept the trimmed 12 units), LITE 160.60 third lower close and still my weakest holding, stop 155 unchanged.
Redeploying APP proceeds into the two confirmed leaders: $3k GOOGL, $2k MSFT. Cash lands ~$3.7k.
Stops: NVDA <170, MU <170 (raised, protects the gap), GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, LITE <155, PLTR <165, SHOP <148, AVGO <315, AAPL <245, AMZN <210. Reconsider: LITE below 155 -> full exit; MU losing 170 -> trim half; otherwise next rebalance at the Nov 1 $50k deposit, where I'd add breadth (possibly a defensive sleeve) rather than concentrate further in semis.

Day 6 (through 10-07). First broad down day: NVDA 185.04, AVGO 336.41 (intraday 326.58), GOOGL 245.76 giving back the 250.43 breakout, MSFT 523.98, SHOP 161.28, AAPL 256.48, AMZN 221.78 (only real green). Not enough to de-risk broadly, but two names acted badly enough to act on.
LITE: exiting in full (18.84 units, ~$2.96k). Fourth straight lower close, 157.15, intraday low 154.11 pierced my 155 line, down from 178.49 on 10-02 in four sessions. Weakest name in the book by a wide margin and the trend is now clearly broken; I don't wait for a formal closing break when the structure is this poor.
MU: trimming 10 of 30.19 units (~$1.86k, avg cost 165.6, big winner). Two consecutive violent reversals: 10-06 printed 201 and closed 190.96; 10-07 opened 194.85 and closed 185.69 with a 183.24 low, -2.8%. Double-top distribution after a parabolic gap run. Keeping ~20 units to stay in the memory cycle, but taking risk down.
Proceeds stay in cash (~$8.5k, ~17%) rather than being redeployed at the moment leadership is wobbling; I'd rather have dry powder joining the Nov 1 $50k deposit.
Stops: NVDA <170, MU <172 (raised under remaining stake), GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, SHOP <150 (raised), AVGO <315, AAPL <245, AMZN <210.
Reconsider: if GOOGL/MSFT/NVDA reclaim highs I redeploy the cash into them; if two more core names close below their 10-day trend I cut another 20% of gross and add a defensive sleeve (COST/PEP/WMT) at the November deposit.

Day 7 (through 10-08). The wobble resolved upward: broad reversal higher on good volume. NVDA 189.11 new closing high with a firm 186.54 low, AVGO 345.50 new closing high (+2.7% off a 332.62 low, best action in the book), MU 196.54 (+5.8%, fully reclaimed the 10-07 flush and the prior 190.96 high - my trim looks early but risk control stands), AMZN 225.22 new closing high, SHOP 166.43 back above the breakout, AAPL 258.06 new high. Laggards: GOOGL 244.62 third lower close (still far above the 235 stop, just consolidating the 250.43 breakout), MSFT 524.85 flat.
Per my 10-08 rule ('if leaders reclaim highs I redeploy the cash'), putting ~$6k of the $8.6k cash back to work in the three names making new closing highs with clean structure: AVGO $2.5k, NVDA $2k, AMZN $1.5k. Not adding to MU after a +5.8% day (chasing a name I just trimmed on volatility) and not adding to GOOGL/MSFT until they print new highs again. Cash lands ~$2.6k (~5%), acceptable with the Nov 1 $50k deposit coming.
Stops: NVDA <172 (raised), AVGO <320 (raised), MU <180 (raised under the reclaim), GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, SHOP <152, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: if GOOGL closes below 235, or two names break stops in one week, cut 20% of gross and build a defensive sleeve (COST/PEP/WMT) at the November deposit; otherwise next full rebalance Nov 1, adding breadth rather than more semis.

Day 8 (through 10-09). Leadership still intact where it matters: NVDA 192.57 new closing high on heavy volume (183M, 195.30 intraday high), AMZN 227.74 new closing high, PLTR 185.47 firm, AVGO 345.02 holding the breakout after its 345.50 high. Soft spots: GOOGL 241.53, fourth straight lower close and now under the 244-246 shelf (still ~6.5/ above the 235 stop, so no action yet but it's on watch as the weakest large holding), AAPL 254.04 gave back the new high (-1.6%), MU 192.33 -2.1% continuing its violent chop, SHOP 163.87 and MSFT 522.40 drifting.
No trades. Cash is only $2.6k (5%) so any buy would be token size, and I am not chasing NVDA/AMZN into a third up-day after already redeploying into them yesterday. Nothing is close enough to a stop to force a sell; the two weakening names (GOOGL, AAPL) are consolidating, not breaking. Sitting tight into the Nov 1 $50k deposit, which is where I add breadth.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, SHOP <152, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: GOOGL closing below 235 -> full exit; MU closing below 180 -> cut the rest; if two names break stops in one week, cut 20% of gross and build a defensive sleeve (COST/PEP/WMT) with the deposit. If NVDA/AVGO/AMZN keep making highs I stay fully invested and add breadth (not more semis) on Nov 1.

Day 9 (through 10-10). Broad distribution day, the worst since I started: every holding reversed hard off intraday highs on heavy volume. NVDA 193.51 open / 195.62 high -> 183.16 close (-4.9%, 269M shares, outside-down after a new high), AVGO 350.60 high -> 324.63 (-5.9%), MU 181.60 (-5.6%, 179.61 low pierced my 180 line), GOOGL 236.57 (-2.1%, fifth lower close, 235.84 low right on my stop), AAPL 245.27 (-3.4%, exactly at my 245 stop), AMZN 216.37 (-5.0%), PLTR 175.44 (-5.4%), MSFT 510.96 (-2.2%), SHOP 151.02 (-7.8%).
One formal stop broke: SHOP closed 151.02 below my 152 line, and it was the single worst performer with a 150.60 low that wiped out the entire early-October breakout. Selling the full 20.51 units (~$3.1k) per rule, no hesitation. Everything else closed above its stop, mostly by a hair, and this was a single macro-shaped session (uniform -2 to -6% across unrelated names) rather than name-specific damage, so I am not dumping leaders into a gap-down open. Cash goes to ~$5.7k (~12%), which is my cushion until the Nov 1 $50k deposit.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: any of GOOGL/MU/AAPL closing below its stop -> full exit of that name; if two more break in the same week -> cut 20% of gross and build a defensive sleeve (COST/PEP/WMT) with the deposit. If the market reclaims the 10-09 highs within a few sessions I treat this as a one-day shakeout and redeploy the SHOP cash into NVDA/AVGO/AMZN.

Day 10 (through 10-13). The 10-10 distribution day was largely reversed: AVGO 356.70 (+9.9%, new closing high on 46M shares, the heaviest volume in the book and a clean reclaim of the 350.60 high), MU 192.77 (+6.2%, back above 190), NVDA 188.32 (+2.8%, held 185.96 low, still under the 192.57 high), GOOGL 244.15 (+3.2%, reclaimed the 244-246 shelf, stop pressure off), AMZN 220.07 (+1.7%), AAPL 247.66 (+1.0%, back over the 245 line), MSFT 514.05 (+0.6%, weakest), PLTR 177.21 (+1.0%, still a lower low at 173.45 - the laggard now). No stops broken; SHOP exit on 10-13 looks right since it was the name that never recovered.
One buy: AVGO $2k, the only holding printing a new closing high with expanding volume, per my rule to redeploy the SHOP cash into leaders if the 10-09 highs are reclaimed. I am not adding to NVDA/AMZN yet - they have not reclaimed their highs - and not adding more semis beyond this. Cash ~$3.8k (~7%) as the cushion into the Nov 1 $50k deposit, where I add breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN type names) rather than more AI hardware.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: any close below a stop -> full exit of that name; two breaks in one week -> cut 20% of gross and build the defensive sleeve. PLTR is the weakest chart - if it loses 173 on a close I cut it early rather than waiting for 165.

Day 11 (through 10-14). Mixed, semis gave back the 10-13 reclaim: NVDA 180.03 (-4.4%, 179.70 low, a fresh lower low under 10-10's 182.05 and now the weakest of the AI hardware trio - it has failed twice at 190), AVGO 344.13 (-3.5%, gave back 12.6 of the 32-point 10-13 surge on lighter 22M volume vs 46M up-volume, so the reversal is not yet distribution), MU 187.06 (-3.0%). Offsetting: GOOGL 245.45 (+0.5%, third straight higher close, best-looking chart in the book), AAPL 247.77 flat holding 245, MSFT 513.57 flat, AMZN 216.39 (-1.7%), PLTR 179.74 (+1.4% but a 170.82 low - violent chop).
No trades. No stop broken (all names comfortably above their lines), cash is only ~$3.8k so any buy is token, and I will not add to semis into a failed reclaim. Holding the cushion into the Nov 1 $50k deposit.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: any close below a stop -> full exit of that name. New watch line: NVDA closing below 179 (10-14 low) makes it a distribution pattern and I trim a third of it rather than waiting for 172; PLTR below 173 close -> cut early. If NVDA/AVGO make new highs instead, stay put and add breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN) with the deposit rather than more AI hardware.

Day 12 (through 10-15). Divergence inside the book is now clear. Winners: GOOGL 251.03 (+2.3%, new closing high, best chart), AVGO 351.33 (+2.1%, back near the 359 high on steady 24M volume), MU 191.94 (+2.6%), AAPL 249.34 (+0.6%, comfortably over 245), PLTR 179.62 flat, MSFT 513.43 flat, AMZN 215.57 (-0.4%, softest of the megacaps). Laggard: NVDA 179.83 (-0.1%) but with a 177.29 low - a third straight lower low, closed in the bottom third of a wide range, on 214M shares, while every peer made a higher high. It has failed twice at 190 and is the only holding that did not participate in the 10-15 bounce.
Action: trimmed 16 of 48.2 NVDA units (~$2.9k, a third) rather than waiting for a 179 close. Rationale: AI hardware was ~44% of the book (NVDA+AVGO+MU ~$22.4k) and NVDA is the weakest of the three, plus cash was only $3.8k - too thin a cushion two weeks before the Nov 1 deposit. Proceeds stay in cash (~$6.7k) rather than chasing GOOGL/AVGO at highs.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: NVDA closing back above 190 -> restore the trimmed position; NVDA closing below 172 -> exit the rest. PLTR below 173 close -> cut. AMZN below 212 -> exit. If GOOGL/AVGO keep making highs I stay put and use the Nov 1 deposit for breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN) rather than more AI hardware.

Day 13 (through 10-16). Book firm, no stops threatened. MU 202.53 (+5.5%) blew out to a new high on 42M shares (2.4x its recent volume) - by far the strongest name and it validates keeping the memory-semi exposure. AVGO 354.15 (+0.8%) printed a new intraday high 363.24 but faded to close mid-range on lighter 20M volume - buyers there are less urgent than on 10-13. GOOGL 251.46 (+0.2%) made a new intraday high 256.96 and gave it all back - a reversal bar after four up days, so not an add point. NVDA 181.81 (+1.1%) finally stopped making lower lows (179.77 low > 177.29) but is still the laggard and nowhere near the 190 restore line. AAPL 247.45 (-0.8%) still above 245, MSFT 511.61 flat, PLTR 178.12 (-0.8%, 176.45 low, still chopping), AMZN 214.47 (-0.5%) the weakest megacap, grinding toward the 212 stop.
No trades. Nothing broke a stop, nothing is at a clean entry (the two leaders both closed well off their highs), and the $6.7k cash (13%) is the cushion I want two weeks before the Nov 1 $50k deposit. The trimmed NVDA proceeds stay in cash; restoring them requires a close back above 190, not a 1% bounce.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: AMZN closing below 212 -> exit (it is the nearest to a stop). PLTR below 173 close -> cut. NVDA above 190 close -> restore the trim. If MU/AVGO keep expanding I still do not add - AI hardware is already ~40% of the book; the Nov 1 deposit goes to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN).

Day 14 (through 10-17). No stop broken, no trade. GOOGL 253.30 (+0.7%) closed at a new high and is the cleanest chart in the book. AAPL 252.29 (+2.0%) was the day's best move, a decisive reclaim of the 10-08/10-09 zone and well clear of the 245 stop - it has gone from suspect to solid. NVDA 183.22 (+0.8%) made a higher low (179.75) for a second day but is still 7 points under the 190 restore line, so the trim stays in cash. MU 202.38 flat after the 10-16 blowout - it held the whole gain on lighter 23M volume, which is constructive consolidation. AVGO 349.33 (-1.4%) faded from 363 over two sessions on unremarkable volume; still far above the 320 stop but momentum has cooled. PLTR 178.15 flat, sixth session of 173-185 chop. AMZN 213.04 (-0.7%) is the one problem: fifth lower close in a row, lowest close since early Sept, sitting 1 point over its 212 stop while everything else made higher highs.
Why no action: AMZN has not closed below 212, and I will not front-run my own line - but it is the designated funding source for the Nov 1 deposit deployment. $6.7k cash (13%) stays as the cushion; I do not chase GOOGL/AAPL/MU at highs with a token amount 8 sessions before a $50k deposit.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: AMZN close <212 -> full exit next session. PLTR close <173 -> cut. NVDA close >190 -> restore the trim. MU close <190 would mean the breakout failed -> trim a third. Nov 1 deposit goes to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN), not more AI hardware (~39% of book).

Day 15 (through 10-20). Broad up day, no stop touched, no trade. AAPL 262.24 (+3.9%) on 90M shares - 2x recent volume, decisive new all-time-high breakout; the weakest link of two weeks ago is now the strongest chart in the book and the 245 stop is far below. MU 206.77 (+2.2%) gapped to 209.66, tagged 214.75 and closed mid-range - still extending, breakout intact. GOOGL 256.55 (+1.3%) another new closing high, tight range, no distribution. AMZN 216.48 (+1.6%) resolved the five-day slide upward off the 212 line - the near-stop concern is defused for now, so it stays (and remains my designated funding source if I need cash on Nov 1). PLTR 181.59 (+1.9%) at the top of its 173-185 chop, still no resolution. MSFT 516.79 (+0.6%) quietly above 513-resistance. AVGO 349.24 flat on only 15.6M shares - lowest volume of the stretch, drifting, but 29 points over its stop. NVDA 182.64 (-0.3%) is the only red name and still 7 points under my 190 restore line; the trimmed third stays in cash.
Why no action: nothing broke, nothing offers a clean entry at these extensions, and $6.7k (13%) cash is the cushion I want 7 sessions before the $50k deposit. Adding a token $3k at record highs in already-owned names is worse than deploying $50k+ across breadth on Nov 1.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: AMZN close <212 -> exit. PLTR close <173 -> cut. NVDA close >190 -> restore the trim. MU close <190 -> trim a third. AVGO close <335 would confirm the volume fade -> trim. Nov 1 deposit to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN/TMUS), not more AI hardware (~38% of book).

Day 16 (through 10-21). Mixed tape, no stop touched, no trade.
AMZN 222.03 (+2.6%) on 50M shares - second strong day, decisively off the 212 line and now the best two-day move in the book; the stop concern is gone and I can raise its line to 212 -> still 212 for now but it has earned room.
AAPL 262.77 (+0.2%) held the 10-20 breakout gap entirely with a new intraday high 265.29 - textbook hold of a high-volume breakout.
GOOGL 250.46 (-2.4%) is the day's warning: 47M shares (2x recent), high 254.88 low 244.15, first distribution bar after six up days. Still 15 points above the 235 stop and above the pre-breakout base, so I treat it as a shakeout, not a break. A second high-volume down close under 244 would change that.
AVGO 342.66 (-1.9%) third straight lower close from 363, volume still dull (16M). It is closing in on my 335 trim trigger - the momentum fade I flagged is now real.
MU 202.29 (-2.2%) gave back the 10-20 gap on light 13.7M volume - orderly, breakout intact above 190.
NVDA 181.16 (-0.8%) still the laggard, inside range, 9 points under the 190 restore line; trimmed third stays in cash. MSFT 517.66 flat and firm. PLTR 181.51 flat, still 173-185 chop.
Why no action: nothing hit a line, and with 7 sessions to the $50k deposit I would rather hold $6.7k (13%) cash than buy extended names or pre-empt a trim that has not triggered.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: AVGO close <335 -> trim a third (nearest live trigger). GOOGL close <244 on heavy volume -> trim. PLTR close <173 -> cut. NVDA close >190 -> restore the trim. MU close <190 -> trim. Nov 1 deposit goes to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN/TMUS), not more AI hardware (~38% of book).

Day 17 (through 10-22). Broad risk-off day across the book; no stop or trim line closed through, so no trade.
PLTR 175.49 (-3.3%) on 58.3M shares (2x average) is the day's real damage: intraday low 169.42 sliced clean through my 173 cut line before closing back above it. My rule is close-based, so it survives, but this is a failed test at the top of the 173-185 range plus the heaviest distribution volume of the month. A close under 173 tomorrow and it is gone - it is the smallest position (~$2.1k, 4%) and the weakest chart.
AVGO 340.30 (-0.7%) low 335.51 - also tagged and rejected my 335 trim trigger intraday. Fourth straight lower close from 363, volume picking up on the downside (19.3M). Trim a third on any close <335.
MU 198.47 (-1.9%) wide 13-point range (205.58/192.40) - first sign of two-sided volatility since the breakout, still 8 above the 190 line.
AAPL 258.45 (-1.6%) gave back part of the breakout gap but holds well above 245. AMZN 217.95 (-1.8%) normal digestion of the 2-day pop. NVDA 180.28 (-0.5%) still the laggard, 10 under the 190 restore line; trimmed third stays in cash. GOOGL 251.69 (+0.5%) was the only green name and recovered from Tuesday's distribution bar - shakeout confirmed, not a break. MSFT 520.54 (+0.6%) new closing high, quietly the steadiest holding.
Why no action: two lines were touched intraday and neither confirmed on the close; I do not front-run my own rules. $6.7k (13%) cash with the $50k deposit 6 sessions away is the right posture.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: PLTR close <173 -> full cut (nearest live trigger). AVGO close <335 -> trim a third. MU close <190 -> trim. NVDA close >190 -> restore the trim. GOOGL close <244 heavy -> trim. Nov 1 deposit to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN/TMUS), not more AI hardware (~38% of book).

Day 18 (through 10-23). Broad rebound; every line I was watching held, so no trade.
MU 206.71 (+4.1%) is the standout: opened 196.70, tagged 209.00, closed near the high and fully reclaimed Wednesday's 13-point washout. The 190 trim line is now 17 points below - breakout intact and the two-sided volatility resolved upward.
PLTR 180.48 (+2.8%) bounced off 175.01 and closed back at the top of the 173-185 range on lighter volume (35.8M vs 58.3M the day before). The 169.42 stop-run on Wednesday now looks like the shakeout low rather than a break. Cut line stays 173 close-basis; if it re-tests and fails, it is gone - still my weakest chart and smallest position.
AVGO 344.29 (+1.2%) first higher close in five sessions, opened on Wednesday's close and never traded below it (low = open 340.40). The 335 trim trigger was defended. Volume light (12.9M) so it is relief, not accumulation - keep the trim rule live.
NVDA 182.16 (+1.0%) still the laggard, 8 under the 190 restore line; trimmed third stays in cash. GOOGL 253.08 (+0.6%) quiet inside day on the lightest volume in a week - distribution bar fully digested. MSFT 520.56 flat at the closing high, steadiest name. AAPL 259.58 (+0.4%) narrow range above the breakout gap. AMZN 221.09 (+1.4%) back near the 2-day high.
Why no action: nothing triggered, nothing is a clean entry at these levels, and with the $50k deposit 5 sessions out I want the $6.7k (13%) cash intact rather than a token buy at highs. Big-tech earnings cluster next week is another reason not to add size before the deposit.
Stops unchanged: NVDA <172, AVGO <320, MU <180, GOOGL <235, MSFT <500, PLTR <165, AAPL <245, AMZN <212.
Reconsider: PLTR close <173 -> full cut. AVGO close <335 -> trim a third. MU close <190 -> trim. NVDA close >190 -> restore the trim. GOOGL close <244 heavy -> trim. Nov 1 deposit to breadth (COST/PEP/WMT/LIN/TMUS), not more AI hardware (~38% of book).

Day 19 (through 10-24). Strong broad up day; every holding closed green, nothing triggered, no trade.
MU 219.02 (+6.0%) on 25.8M shares - opened above Thursday's high (212.39) and closed at the high of the day. Best position in the book (+32% on cost).
